Happy Thursday! **Swin** here. This morning we're talking "ass," and lots of
it. I don't mean to sound crass, though. I'm merely directly quoting the
president of the United States, who won't stop talking about one Ohio
politician's sweet, manly, and above all muscle-bound behind.

In today's **' First Draft**,' we'll get right into _why_ Donald Trump keeps
obsessing about **Senator Jon Husted 's** bottom, even when he's not
physically campaigning in Husted's state - and yes, our reporting shows
there's a deeper reason for this that you may not have considered. Plus, a new
ad from Trump's super PAC, MAGA Inc., points to a sad truth for deputy chief
of staff and White House policy vampire **Stephen Miller** : Voters prefer not
to see him. There's worrying Iran war news too. In we go.

# The Assman Cometh

Ohio. Photo by Alex Wong/Getty Images._

"**They love it**!" President Donald Trump has privately said, according to a
person familiar with the matter.

This source, along with two other Republicans close to the president, talked
to me about how much Trump, during these critical final weeks of the 2026 U.S.
midterm elections, has marveled to advisers and close allies about how much
his rally audiences have been eating up his recurring monologues praising Ohio
Republican Senator Jon Husted's** "ass."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Trump, who lives and breathes by the validation he gets from his cult-driven
rally-goers, pays close attention to what draws the biggest applause and the
loudest laughs and boos. In recent days, he's road-tested his **" ass"**
fixation at multiple venues. Trump is now so all-in on Husted's allegedly
wonderful, tight **" ass"** that he's using it in speeches _even when he 's
not in Ohio, _as was the case in North Carolina this week. (I'm an Ohio
resident and voter, and Husted's buttcheeks don't have any material or
political impact on my or my family's life - that must be exponentially truer
to any voter in North Carolina, or in any state that isn't the Buckeye one.)

**" I did a rally in a place called Dayton," **Trump said first, in
Youngstown, Ohio, earlier this month. **" I don't do this with men very often.
I started examining his body because I didn't know he was a great athlete. And
I looked, and I watched up and down. I looked at his ass, and I looked at the
whole... And then I looked at his hands. Look at his hands. He's got these
like claws."**

Then, in northern Kentucky - near Ohio, at least, if not in it - Trump
[said](https://www.advocate.com/politics/national/donald-trump-jon-husted-
bizarre): **" He came up, and he was talking very nicely, and I stood right
over here, and I examined his ass. I never did that with a man before. I
examined his ass, and then I looked at his shoulders, I looked at his feet, I
looked at his hand, I looked at his jawline, studying."**

And on Tuesday in North Carolina, the president
[said](https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=1743822143386172):** "So he's over
here, I'm over here. And I'm studying his body. I've never studied the body of
a man before. It's not my thing. Nothing wrong with it of course… But I looked
at his ass. And then I looked at his legs. And I said, 'His ass is, it's like
a pile of muscle."**

So why is he doing this? What do the sources say?
